annotations.title: Change the hook or call to action

description: CHANGE THE HOOK OR CALL TO ACTION of a finished video ad in the user's own words. The new words are said where the old ones were, in the speaker's own voice (a paid plan; a matching voice on Free), and the mouth is re-synced to them in that moment alone; every other frame, line, the music and the length stay the source's. hook = the opening sentence, cta = the closing sentence, line = any other spoken line at {atSeconds, text}; hook and cta can go in one call. A new line must fit the moment it replaces at a natural pace: a longer one is refused before anything renders, with the word count that fits. A video nobody speaks in is refused (new words on screen are post_edit text). quoteOnly:true = the price, free. Returns ONE video; the original is kept.

cta.description: the new call to action, verbatim (e.g. 'Tap the link and get 20% off today')

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

hook.description: the new opening line, verbatim (e.g. 'Stop scrolling if your skin hates winter')

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

line.description: any other spoken line: the moment it is said and the new words

video.description: the finished video: a file URL, a render, a job result or list_library; a URL, not a local file path; use upload_file for local files

voice.description: a named voice instead of the speaker's own, e.g. 'Aria' or 'George' (only when the user asks)
